title: Browser Wars 2026: We Pitted 5 New AI-Powered Contenders Against Chrome
angle: Forget the old speed tests. We're evaluating the new wave of browsers on the features that matter now: AI integration, real privacy protections, and unique workflows to see if any are actually worth the switch.
rationale: This piece provides immediate, actionable value by helping readers navigate a confusing but important software category that's changing rapidly.

source_articles.title: The browser wars aren’t about search anymore — here are the best alternatives to Chrome and Safari
source_articles.excerpt: We’ve compiled an overview of some of the top alternative browsers available today aiming to challenge Chrome and Safari.
